# Cold brew at home

Cold brew is coffee steeped in cold water for twelve hours or more. Making it at home takes a jar, a filter and some patience.

## How to make a concentrate

Steep one part coarse coffee in four parts water, then strain it.

## Benefits of a long steep

A long steep pulls out sweetness and leaves most of the acidity behind.

## Cold brew vs iced coffee

Iced coffee is hot coffee poured over ice, so it tastes brighter and thinner.

### Glass or plastic jars

Glass does not hold on to old flavors, so it is the easier jar to keep clean.

## Why the taste is smoother

Cold water dissolves fewer of the sharp acids than hot water does.

## Gear you need

Is cold brew stronger than espresso? People ask this a lot, and the answer depends on the dilution.

- Should you add milk?
- A fine mesh filter
